pulls.title: 8067946: StackYellowPages and StackRedPages have no effect on Windows
pulls.author: raneashay
pulls.body_excerpt: Prior to this patch, the `StackYellowPages` and `StackRedPages` influenced the total reserved stack memory, but they didn't change the minimum stack size specified as required by HotSpot to Windows. This patch adds the call to `SetThreadStackGuarantee()` to set the minimum stack size. The key change here is that the argument to `SetThreadStackGuarantee()` is set to one less than the total number of yellow pages. pulls.author: merykitty
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, This PR reimplements `Type::meet` and `Type::join` so that the implementation is easier to reason about, better accomodate the newly added dimensions from Valhalla, and resolves some Valhalla issues that were uncovered by this change. Currently, the `Type` in the compiler works based on the lattice theory, this is pretty complicated, and it does not interact well with components that do not lie on a lattice, such as `TypeInt` and `TypeInterfaces`. pulls.title: 8381180: GenShen: Account for time required to independently execute each GC phase
pulls.author: kdnilsen
pulls.body_excerpt: The purpose of this PR is to individually model the time required to perform each phase of GC, specificially mark, evac, update, and final-roots. This allows us to more accurately predict the time that will be required to perform a GC operation. We maintain the existing mechanisms that predict typical GC times as an average and as a linear trend analysis of recently completed typical GC efforts.
